notes: Pages opened (3 of up to 5): Yiqu, Queen Dowager Xuan, Qin (state; silent on Yiqu). Wikidata id left null (unreachable). FAMILY steppe (a Rong people of the Hetao), not china; the colour agent may choose. START -720 is the page's 'c. 720 BC' first mention and infobox founding. AREA: the page gives none, so there is no comparison with Cliopatria (which has no Yiqu row). Region discs are the researcher's reading of a four-region description; the ceded cities and the 327 county are placed at the Qin-facing eastern Gansu edge because the page names no place; capital Miaojuping is the infobox's. QIN SIDE MISSING: the qin dossier (ea-01-b) has no Yiqu event; it needs a vassal_start (counterpart yiqu) in 327, a gain in 315 (twenty-five cities) and a gain in 272; its 316 'Western Rong tribes' gain is undated by its own page. The 272 'long walls' Qin built against other peoples (Yiqu page) are not territory and are left for the frontier-walls addition (see _notes). NOT DRAWN: the mid-4th century first defeat of Qin and c. 460 BC attacks on other Rong (no place, no result). Page silent: Qingshui and the Wei dispute.
